description: One product by the product_id search_catalog returned: product facts only, without source-shop details. Read-only. Return products without source-shop details. If a city is not a served market, ask for a 5-digit ZIP; never present national fallback as local. After a product is chosen, call get_buying_options for both local_delivery and ship_to_home with its exact product_id, zip and quantity. Offer only verified modes; same-day requires a verified local_delivery result. If neither mode is available, say so without asking the shopper to choose. Then call start_checkout with that product_id, zip, quantity and chosen fulfillment_mode; JENNi selects the source internally.

market.description: Market key, e.g. san-antonio-tx. Used when no zip is given.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, for local prices and delivery options.

name: get_product

color.description: Colour of the variant product_id names; null when it has none.

offers.description: JENNi's single best offer for this product (price, delivery_promise, fulfilled_by, is_eligible_checkout), without source-shop details.

availability.description: NULL when we have no shelf read under 24 hours old (shelf_observed_at says when). Do not call it in or out of stock; when is_eligible_checkout is true it can still be ordered.

delivery_promise.description: Shopper-facing delivery promise, e.g. "Get it today" (local delivery) or "Ships to you".

fulfillment.description: `local_delivery`: delivered locally. `concierge`: JENNi collects it from the shop and delivers it; buy it with start_checkout like any orderable offer. `ship_to_home`: shipped to the shopper. `in_store_only`: observed on the shelf, but it cannot be ordered through JENNi. `pickup` is store-owned capability metadata, not a JENNi customer reservation/ready/handoff flow, and is never returned. These are not executable MCP methods: ordering happens on the storefront.

is_eligible_checkout.description: True: this offer can be ordered through JENNi; call start_checkout with it when the shopper wants to buy. start_checkout and the checkout page re-check the offer and say why if it can no longer be ordered, so do not ask the shopper to confirm stock or hours first. False: do not send the shopper to checkout for this offer. Nothing is charged until the shopper places the order on the checkout page.

price.description: USD, e.g. "$12.50". Null when we hold no current price.

product_id.description: The exact variant this offer covers.

shelf_observed_at.description: When the shelf was last read. Null means never.

shelf_price.description: Observed shelf price. Browse information only; not a checkout price. Use `price` and is_eligible_checkout for purchase.

url.description: Storefront page for this exact product.

price.description: Headline price in USD; null when none is held.

shelf_price.description: Observed shelf price. Browse information only; not a checkout price. Use `price` and is_eligible_checkout for purchase.

size.description: Size of the variant product_id names; null when it has none.

url.description: Storefront product page, where the buyer picks size/colour, checks out as a guest (email, no account) and pays. Null when no storefront is configured.

variants.description: Buyable size/colour variants. Give the shopper the variant url so the page opens on that choice. search_catalog lists at most 30; get_product lists all.

url.description: Storefront page opened on this variant.

title: Product details
